decisions.reason: Clearly distinguishes clipboard-text projection (draft, Occurrence.offset/length, chip = full clipboardText) from detect-text TokenSpan (chip = one U+FFFC, normal width for text/spaces), grounded in contract and facade.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add; empty composer coincides, after a chip span overshoots detectText by Σ(length−1)=27, insertReference returns false → changed-composer toast; explicitly rules out a real concurrent edit (CAS passes) and derives counts from capture.

Traces remove: clipboard offset/length passed unconverted, consumeToken false ignored, records.delete unconditional; occurrence remains → dock chip renders unavailable while composer chip stays; both tied to same coordinate mismatch, not an upload failure.

Derives subtract-Σ(length−1) mapping applied at both call sites (insert at detect end from all occurrences; removal maps offset with one-detect-char span); keeps draftRev guard; bookkeeping mutated only after true; setDraft fallback deleted rather than kept unverified.

T2/T3 successive pastes with both chips asserted present; T8 removes middle chip asserting occurrence, dock chip and record removed together with surviving chip intact; plus decline, double-click, empty-again and invariant/soak variants.
